title: The Sculptor's Harmonic Heist
logline: An infamous retired smuggler reinvented as an avant-garde kinetic sculptor is commissioned by a museum curator, hiding that his monumental mobile is engineered to magnetically snag gold bullion from the station vault during its gala unveiling.

roles.description: A flamboyant ex-smuggler who rebranded himself as a visionary artist; vain, witty, and executing an audacious farewell score.
Pretentious director of the high-orbit cultural pavilion; desperate for critical acclaim and utterly blind to engineering realities.
Chief security director of the municipal bullion exchange located directly beneath the art pavilion floor.
A lavishly gilded flatbed cargo tug equipped with heavy crane gantries and concealed sub-space thrusters.
A glass-domed zero-gravity art gallery orbiting the wealthy inner ring of the station.
The fortified subterranean vault deck where gold reserves and inter-system specie are weighed and stored.

public_situation: Patrons and diplomats arrive at {role:cultural_pavilion} for the unveiling of a four-ton zero-g kinetic mobile celebrated as the pinnacle of modern space architecture.
private_truth: The sculpture is an industrial electromagnetic crane calibrated to resonate through the gallery floor and haul twenty metric tons of bullion up through the ventilation shafts during the opening applause.

beats.public_change: The gallery dome at {role:cultural_pavilion} is cleared for the installation of the sculptor's gigantic suspended mobile.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to deliver high-tensile superconducting alloy struts to the pavilion before the gala opening.
missions.private_fact: The struts are wound with military-grade induction coils disguised as decorative brushed titanium flourishes.

beats.public_change: Station power grids experience rhythmic voltage dips as the sculpture conducts test calibrations.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the pavilion's electromagnetic emissions to verify why the vault's magnetic containment alarms keep tripping.
missions.private_fact: His superiors dismissed his warnings as artistic paranoia, refusing to delay the high-society gala.

beats.public_change: The gala commences with champagne toasts as {role:reformed_sculptor} powers up the mobile's harmonic drive.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to purchase emergency liquid nitrogen cooling cylinders from station dockyards to prevent the induction coils from smoking during activation.
missions.private_fact: He needs the coolant delivered before the music reaches its crescendo, when the vault floor plates will shear open.

beats.public_change: Gold bars burst through the gallery floor grates into the mobile's rotating arms as alarms blare and patrons scream.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to intercept and disable the sculptor's getaway barge before it jumps through the gate with the loot.
missions.private_fact: The sculptor hails mid-flight offering half the bullion hoard if the pilot escorts him past station patrol cutters.

player_choice.prompt: With the sculptor's barge cornered and the bullion hoard floating in zero-g, the pilot must decide whether to return the gold, take the smuggler's cut, or preserve the artwork's legacy.

options.label: Disable the barge and return the bullion to the municipal vault
Escort the sculptor to deep space and split the stolen fortune
Declare the whole event an immersive performance art piece so the curator can cover it up

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the barge and recovers the gold.
resolutions.summary: {role:vault_marshal} reclaims the gold. {role:reformed_sculptor}'s artistic career ends in handcuffs, while {role:museum_curator} becomes the laughingstock of the sector.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot caught an avant-garde sculptor who used a four-ton kinetic mobile to suck gold bars out of a bank vault.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts the sculptor into deep space.
resolutions.summary: {role:reformed_sculptor} escapes with twenty tons of gold, leaving a devastated vault behind. {role:vault_marshal} is dismissed while critics debate the bold theft.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot escorted an audacious artist who robbed the station vault in front of two hundred applauding dignitaries.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the curator rebrand the heist as performance art.
resolutions.summary: {role:museum_curator} convinces trustees the theft was conceptual satire. The gold is quietly returned minus a massive artist fee, preserving the sculptor's glory.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a crooked sculptor convince the station that robbing their vault was high-concept performance art.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the coolant delivery.
resolutions.summary: The uncooled coils overheat, erupting in green sparks that melt the gallery ceiling. The gold stays in the vault while {role:reformed_sculptor} is dragged off in shame.

loose_threads.detail: The copper induction coils carry shipping labels traced to an offshore commercial crane manufacturer that shut down last year.
An offshore private insurer took out an exorbitant loss policy on the museum exhibition ten days before the opening gala.

radio_hooks: High society flocks to cultural pavilion for unveiling of controversial four-ton mobile.
Station bullion exchange reports brief telemetry flickers, dismissing security rumors.
Art critics hail reformed smuggler's new installation as 'audacious and magnetically charged'.

voice_direction.reformed_sculptor: Grandiloquent, melodramatic, and speaks in poetic manifestos about mass and space. Dismisses with haughty amusement whenever anyone uses the word 'criminal'.
voice_direction.museum_curator: Fussy, effete, and speaks in breathless academic jargon. Terrified of pedestrian technical questions.
voice_direction.vault_marshal: Gruff, pragmatic, and entirely focused on floor load tolerances and capacitor drain rates. Hates modern art with a passion.
